items.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder, its first frontier model, via Meta Model API
items.summary: Meta launched Muse Wonder, a larger model than Muse Spark that is strong at coding and long-term 'active memory'. API pricing is $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, in line with GPT-6 Sol and Opus 5.5.
items.whyItMatters: Another frontier-priced LLM option for the tutor's brain, and its active memory could inspire learner-memory features, though voice and French support weren't mentioned.

items.title: Mistral unveils Large 4 (ML4), a 1T-parameter open-weight model
items.summary: French startup Mistral announced ML4, an open-weight model it says rivals top Chinese open models. Weights are scheduled for public release in late October 2026.
items.whyItMatters: A French-built open-weight LLM could be a strong, self-hostable option for French-language tutoring once the weights ship.
